In exactly the case this branch handles (a step-back that skips the recorded latest), the record is written with `isUpdateAvailable = false` while `latestVersionCode > installedVersionCode`. Consider deriving the flag and the code from the same decision (or gate the written code on the skip state) so the two cannot disagree.
